-- | Provides a single IO action, <a>readResourceStats</a>, that samples
--   the calling process's resource usage (CPU, GC, memory, I/O, threads)
--   and returns it as a <a>LogFormatting</a> / <a>MetaTrace</a> value
--   ready to feed into the hermod-tracing pipeline. Supports Linux, macOS,
--   and Windows; falls back to GHC RTS metrics only on other platforms.
@package hermod-trace-resources
@version 1.0.0

module Hermod.Tracing.Resources.Types

-- | A snapshot of resource usage for the current process, parameterised
--   over the numeric type <tt>a</tt>. The concrete alias
--   <a>ResourceStats</a> fixes <tt>a ~ Word64</tt>.
--   
--   Fields that cannot be measured on the current platform are set to
--   <tt>0</tt>.
data Resources a
Resources :: !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> Resources a

-- | CPU time in centiseconds (1/100 s) since process start, from
--   <tt>/proc/self/stat</tt> on Linux or equivalent OS API.
[rCentiCpu] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | CPU centiseconds spent in the GHC garbage collector (RTS stats).
[rCentiGC] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | CPU centiseconds spent in the mutator, i.e. application code (RTS
--   stats).
[rCentiMut] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Number of major (full-heap) GC runs since process start (RTS stats).
[rGcsMajor] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Number of minor GC runs since process start (RTS stats).
[rGcsMinor] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Cumulative bytes allocated in the heap since process start (RTS
--   stats).
[rAlloc] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Live heap bytes immediately after the last GC run (RTS stats).
[rLive] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Committed heap bytes (total heap size reserved from the OS) (RTS
--   stats).
[rHeap] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Resident set size in bytes: physical memory currently mapped to the
--   process (from the OS kernel).
[rRSS] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Centiseconds spent waiting for block I/O (Linux
--   <tt>/proc/self/stat</tt> only; <tt>0</tt> on other platforms).
[rCentiBlkIO] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | IP packet bytes received since boot (Linux
--   <tt>/proc/self/net/netstat</tt>, only when the <tt>with-netstat</tt>
--   flag is enabled; <tt>0</tt> otherwise).
[rNetRd] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | IP packet bytes transmitted since boot (Linux
--   <tt>/proc/self/net/netstat</tt>, only when the <tt>with-netstat</tt>
--   flag is enabled; <tt>0</tt> otherwise).
[rNetWr] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Filesystem bytes read by the process (from <tt>/proc/self/io</tt> on
--   Linux or equivalent OS API).
[rFsRd] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Filesystem bytes written by the process (from <tt>/proc/self/io</tt>
--   on Linux or equivalent OS API).
[rFsWr] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Number of live GHC green threads (RTS stats).
[rThreads] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Concrete snapshot of resource usage with all fields as <a>Word64</a>
--   counts.
type ResourceStats = Resources Word64
instance GHC.Show.Show a => GHC.Show.Show (Hermod.Tracing.Resources.Types.Resources a)
instance GHC.Generics.Generic (Hermod.Tracing.Resources.Types.Resources a)
instance GHC.Base.Functor Hermod.Tracing.Resources.Types.Resources
instance Hermod.Tracing.Types.LogFormatting Hermod.Tracing.Resources.Types.ResourceStats
instance Hermod.Tracing.Types.MetaTrace Hermod.Tracing.Resources.Types.ResourceStats
instance GHC.Base.Applicative Hermod.Tracing.Resources.Types.Resources
instance Data.Aeson.Types.FromJSON.FromJSON a => Data.Aeson.Types.FromJSON.FromJSON (Hermod.Tracing.Resources.Types.Resources a)
instance Data.Aeson.Types.ToJSON.ToJSON a => Data.Aeson.Types.ToJSON.ToJSON (Hermod.Tracing.Resources.Types.Resources a)


-- | OS-level and RTS resource sampling for the Hermod tracing system.
--   
--   This is the only public module of the package. Import it and call
--   <a>readResourceStats</a> once per sampling interval to obtain a
--   <a>ResourceStats</a> snapshot. The value carries
--   <tt>LogFormatting</tt> and <tt>MetaTrace</tt> instances and can be fed
--   directly into any <tt>Trace IO ResourceStats</tt>.
--   
--   Platform support:
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><b>Linux</b> — CPU, GC, memory (RSS), block I<i>O, filesystem
--   I</i>O, network (opt-in), threads.</li>
--   <li><b>macOS</b> — CPU, GC, memory (RSS), network I<i>O, threads; disk
--   I</i>O stubbed.</li>
--   <li><b>Windows</b> — CPU, GC, memory (RSS), block I/O, threads.</li>
--   <li><b>Other</b> — GHC RTS metrics (CPU, GC, threads) only; OS fields
--   report 0.</li>
--   </ul>
module Hermod.Tracing.Resources

-- | A snapshot of resource usage for the current process, parameterised
--   over the numeric type <tt>a</tt>. The concrete alias
--   <a>ResourceStats</a> fixes <tt>a ~ Word64</tt>.
--   
--   Fields that cannot be measured on the current platform are set to
--   <tt>0</tt>.
data Resources a
Resources :: !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> !a -> Resources a

-- | CPU time in centiseconds (1/100 s) since process start, from
--   <tt>/proc/self/stat</tt> on Linux or equivalent OS API.
[rCentiCpu] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | CPU centiseconds spent in the GHC garbage collector (RTS stats).
[rCentiGC] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | CPU centiseconds spent in the mutator, i.e. application code (RTS
--   stats).
[rCentiMut] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Number of major (full-heap) GC runs since process start (RTS stats).
[rGcsMajor] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Number of minor GC runs since process start (RTS stats).
[rGcsMinor] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Cumulative bytes allocated in the heap since process start (RTS
--   stats).
[rAlloc] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Live heap bytes immediately after the last GC run (RTS stats).
[rLive] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Committed heap bytes (total heap size reserved from the OS) (RTS
--   stats).
[rHeap] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Resident set size in bytes: physical memory currently mapped to the
--   process (from the OS kernel).
[rRSS] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Centiseconds spent waiting for block I/O (Linux
--   <tt>/proc/self/stat</tt> only; <tt>0</tt> on other platforms).
[rCentiBlkIO] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | IP packet bytes received since boot (Linux
--   <tt>/proc/self/net/netstat</tt>, only when the <tt>with-netstat</tt>
--   flag is enabled; <tt>0</tt> otherwise).
[rNetRd] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | IP packet bytes transmitted since boot (Linux
--   <tt>/proc/self/net/netstat</tt>, only when the <tt>with-netstat</tt>
--   flag is enabled; <tt>0</tt> otherwise).
[rNetWr] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Filesystem bytes read by the process (from <tt>/proc/self/io</tt> on
--   Linux or equivalent OS API).
[rFsRd] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Filesystem bytes written by the process (from <tt>/proc/self/io</tt>
--   on Linux or equivalent OS API).
[rFsWr] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Number of live GHC green threads (RTS stats).
[rThreads] :: Resources a -> !a

-- | Concrete snapshot of resource usage with all fields as <a>Word64</a>
--   counts.
type ResourceStats = Resources Word64

-- | Sample resource usage of the current process.
--   
--   Returns <a>Nothing</a> only when the underlying OS interface is
--   unavailable (e.g. <tt>/proc</tt> not mounted). Under normal operating
--   conditions this always returns <a>Just</a>.
--   
--   The returned <a>ResourceStats</a> is a <tt><a>Resources</a>
--   <tt>Word64</tt></tt>; fields that cannot be measured on the current
--   platform are set to <tt>0</tt>.
readResourceStats :: IO (Maybe ResourceStats)
